messages:
Keisha R: MeterMap sent pilot pricing + sample invoice. dropping here for finance/procurement review. highlights: 750k committed tokens/mo, $15 per 1M committed, $30 overage, they offered to waive onboarding for a 3-month pilot. prefer monthly invoices, but asking for net-45. quote: https://vendor-quotes.internal/metermap/21099
Owen L: thanks. paste sample invoice lines and any CSV export format? we need per-request exports for reconciliation.
Keisha R: sample invoice excerpt:
```
INV-21099,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,committed_tokens,750000,15,11.25
INV-21099,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,overage_tokens,125000,30,3.75
INV-21099,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,onboarding_fee,1,0,0.00
```
They said CSV export includes fields: hashed_request_id, timestamp, token_count. asked if that format works.
Marcus (Eng): sounds good if hashed_request_id included. will need sample week of exports to validate. what's their tokenization? same tokenizer as us?
Keisha R: vendor claims compatibility with our tokenizer but will send a short tech note. asked for sample export w/ hashed IDs.
procure-bot: Reminder — create procurement PR before legal: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>. note net-45 requires CFO sign-off; default is net-30.
Nina (Fin): finance checklist: billing entity, W-9 or foreign equivalent, VAT handling, invoice cadence, and written PO acceptance. Finance can approve pilots up to $110k TCV without legal. conditional: if they accept PO/net-30 and provide SOC2 + DPA and onboarding waived in writing, finance will approve PO for 3-month pilot (approx $33.75k). if they insist on net-45 escalate to Legal/CFO.
Owen L: product ask — if they split multi-turn differently we need a mapping table. request per-request token math and a small script snippet for how they tokenize (example code or tokenizer name).
Keisha R: asked vendor for: 1) sample export (one week), 2) tokenizer note + snippet, 3) written confirmation of onboarding waiver and PO acceptance, and 4) SOC2 + DPA.
LegalBot: Loop legal only after PR created and vendor confirms PO/net-45 or wants contract exceptions. attach DPA draft if they request redlines.
Marcus (Eng): ETA: if they deliver sample export + keys by next Mon, we can run reconciliation in 7 business days. need 1 engineer for the job.
Nina (Fin): negotiating play: we accept 3-month pilot with onboarding waived and PO/net-30. offer to consider net-45 only if they provide a 10% pilot discount or extended invoice visibility. Keisha, can you push that?
Keisha R: will push. created PR draft PR-2026-620 to track. will update thread when vendor responds. :thumbsup:
